scene.ko: 코트 두 벌을 입어 보고 비교하다가, 마음에 든 코트에 작은 흠이 있는 것을 보고 할인을 정중히 부탁한다.

lines.en: So, which one do you like better, the camel coat or the gray one?
lines.ko: 그래서, 낙타색 코트랑 회색 코트 중에 어느 게 더 마음에 드세요?

lines.en: I like the camel one better. The gray one feels a bit heavy.
lines.ko: 낙타색이 더 좋아요. 회색은 좀 무거운 느낌이에요.
alt: The camel one, I think. The gray one is a little heavy.
I prefer the camel coat. The gray one feels heavy.

lines.en: Good choice. That one's pure wool, so it's really warm. It's $180.
Hmm, that's a little more than I wanted to spend. Is it part of the sale?
lines.ko: 음, 생각했던 것보다 좀 비싸네요. 이것도 세일 상품인가요?
alt: That's a bit over my budget. Is it on sale?
Hmm, it's more than I planned to spend. Is there a discount on it?

lines.en: I'm afraid not. It's a new arrival, so the sale doesn't apply.
lines.ko: 죄송하지만 아니에요. 신상품이라 세일 대상이 아니에요.

lines.en: I see. Oh, wait. It looks like one of the buttons is loose, and there's a small mark on the sleeve.
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 어, 잠깐만요. 단추 하나가 덜렁거리고 소매에 작은 얼룩이 있는 것 같아요.
alt: Okay. Oh, one of the buttons is loose, and there's a little mark on the sleeve.
I see. Wait, this button is loose, and the sleeve has a small stain.

lines.en: Oh, you're right. Unfortunately, that's the last one in your size.
lines.ko: 아, 그렇네요. 안타깝게도 손님 사이즈로는 그게 마지막이에요.

lines.en: I still really like it. Would you be able to give me a discount because of the damage?
lines.ko: 그래도 정말 마음에 들어요. 흠이 있으니 좀 할인해 주실 수 있을까요?
alt: I still love it. Could you give me a discount since it's damaged?
I'd still like it. Could you take something off because of the damage?

lines.en: Let me check with my manager... Okay, we can take 25% off, and we'll sew the button back on for free.
lines.ko: 매니저에게 확인해 볼게요... 네, 25% 할인해 드리고 단추도 무료로 다시 달아 드릴게요.

lines.en: That's more than fair. I'll take it. Thank you for checking.
lines.ko: 그 정도면 충분해요. 이걸로 살게요. 확인해 주셔서 고마워요.
alt: That's very fair. I'll take it. Thanks for asking your manager.
Sounds great. I'll take it. Thank you for checking.

expressions.note: 둘을 비교할 때 · prefer 와 같은 뜻

expressions.en: That's a little more than I wanted to spend.

expressions.note: 단추가 떨어질 듯할 때 · 나사가 헐거울 때도 씀
